messages:
elena: Dropping the follow-up thread for todays all-hands Q&A. Ask anything on strategy, positioning, market signals, or competitor calls and we'll answer through the day. Recording + slides in the post.

sam: Can leadership clarify the go-to-market tilt? More motion toward Dedicated/Private or keep hosted-first for net-new devs?
nora: also curious how do we succinctly say why customers should pick us vs large cloud providers? one-liners help enablement.
emily: sales ops asks: do we have a public % goal for Dedicated revenue vs hosted this year? reps want a band to target.
akash: tech question: for customers worried about latency on long context windows, what's the simple knob we point them to? quantization, cache, or different model family?
devon: any change to the free-tier limits or onboarding credits after the demo feedback? a few startups hit the cap early.
elena: Quick answers: GTM tilt: we keep developer-first hosted funnel but push sales-assisted deals toward Dedicated/Private for stability and compliance. Internal target: 27%--32% of new-logo ACV from Dedicated/Private this fiscal.
elena: Short battleline vs big providers: "Redwood: single developer API, predictable serving economics, and deployment parity across hosted, dedicated, and private." Keep it benefits-first.
elena: Latency advice: start with KV/prefix caching + batching; use optimized quantization only after validating quality. We'll share a short perf playbook.
ops-bot: Slides + recording: https://redwood/ah/1845002222
emily: great, with a battleline we can update the enablement one-pager.
nora: would leadership like us to explicitly compare feature gaps in enablement (yes/no)?
elena: Yes for enablement: include direct comparisons in internal battleground cards, customer-facing messaging stays product-first.
sam: can we get an annotated roadmap snippet for canary/rollback features for eng and support?
elena: I'll post the roadmap excerpt and an FAQ by EOD. Thanks all  keep questions coming.
